[[Warmaster Grast]] needs you to bring a unit back from [[Regent Valley]] to assist [[Duke Barradin]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = warrior
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to [[Sergeant Clark]] in [[Regent Valley]].
* Escort Sergeant Clark back to [[Warmaster Grast]].

===Reward===
*250 [[Experience]]
*50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
*{{skill icon|Power Attack}}
*{{skill icon|Sprint}}

==Walkthrough==
[[Warmaster Grast]] is located close to [[Ascalon City]], talk to him and then head south-east to [[Regent Valley]]. Enter Regent Valley and you will see [[Sergeant Clark]]; talk to him and return to [[Old Ascalon]] explorable area. Sergeant Clark will be awaiting you with two or three [[Ascalonian Guard]]s, and will start to follow you when approached. Escort Clark back to Warmaster Grast. Ensure his safety; he is a warrior and only has one skill, [[Healing Signet]]. Only Clark needs to survive. There are several [[Devourer]] pop-ups, so try not to over-[[aggro]].

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Humans]] ([[Ascalon]]ians)
*{{w}} 2 (20) [[Sergeant Clark]]
*{{w}} 5 (20) [[Ascalon Guard]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"We have something of a military emergency taking place. When [[Duke Barradin|Barradin]] and his [[Ascalon Vanguard|Vanguard]] broke through the [[Charr]] lines to [[Piken Square]], they created a weak point in their own line. Our scouts report that Charr forces are massing to try to break through the Breach, and we've not enough men in place to stop them. We need to reassign our forces quickly!"''

:''"If you are willing, I'd like you to gather up a patrol that has been watching the road in '''Regent Valley'''. The patrol leader is '''Sergeant Clark'''. I'll need you to bring him and his men back to me for reassignment. What say you?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = You can count on me, sir!
| decline = I respectfully decline.
| ask = What are you still doing here? Find '''Clark''' and his men in '''Regent Valley''' and bring them to me for reassignment.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Sergeant Clark:''' ''"Warmaster Grast orders us to report to him? Lead the way! I know better than to disappoint the Warmaster again. I still haven't recovered from the last time."''
:'''Sergeant Clark:''' ''"Men, prepare to move out! Fall in line behind <Character name>!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Warmaster Grast
:''"The patrol! Well done! You are a credit to Ascalon, <Character name>. Clark, take your men, head in to [[Ascalon City]], and gather as many able-bodied fighters as you can!"''

==Notes==
*The Ascalon Guards follow Sergeant Clark, not the player. If Clark dies, the guards will no longer follow the party.
*The additional allies can make this quest useful for [[vanquish]]ing Old Ascalon and Regent Valley.
